extension.summary: A VCR display and camcorder date stamp for slideshows
extension.description: Makes a slideshow look like an old home video played on a VCR. PLAY, PAUSE, FF and REW show top left as the slideshow runs, and the time and date each photo or home video was taken is stamped bottom right in the Super-VCR Mono typeface, ticking along while a video plays. Works with any skin.
extension.news: v3.0.0: uses the Super-VCR Mono font from resource.font.supervcrmono
